points.description: Chooses white (or light gray) and states that this color would keep the inside of the doghouse cooler because lighter colors reflect more light/absorb less energy than darker colors.

Supports the choice with data from the experiment, e.g. the white lid had the lowest average temperature (42°C) or the smallest temperature increase from 24°C, while the black lid reached the highest average temperature (53°C).

rubric.notes: Full marks require a sensible color choice with a correct explanation of how it affects the doghouse inside and a relevant comparison using the experimental data. A correct alternative color choice can earn credit if it is justified consistently with the data and the intended use of the doghouse. No marks are earned for a color choice with no explanation or for data that is not linked to the choice.
